answer: Give every newcomer a challengeable portfolio. They lock a $160 bond and post 10 client-signed jobs, each with an opal seal, on a public page that acts as a beacon. The portfolio wears a saffron ribbon for 90 days, and anyone can challenge an entry. Three random peers check a challenged job within 7 days and call the client. A false challenge costs the challenger $10, a confirmed fake burns the $160 bond and blocks the profile 180 days. Forging 1,000 fakes needs $160,000 plus 10,000 forged signatures. Like a shop window with the owner's name painted on the glass, anyone can spot a fake.
